changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: occurred_on is the day a line happened: the payment date of what was paid by wallet and the purchase date of a card purchase, whatever the status of its invoice. It goes at the end of the column list so that CREATE OR REPLACE accepts the view, and every other column and condition stays as in 27-1200.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW financial.report_lines AS SELECT m.id_financial_period, m.type, m.id_cost_center, m.id_classification, p.value_paid AS value, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM financial.recurring_launches rl WHERE rl.id_movement = m.id) AS fixed, p.paid_on AS occurred_on FROM financial.movements m JOIN financial.payments p ON p.id_movement = m.id WHERE p.method = 'WALLET' AND m.id_invoice IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT i.id_financial_period, 'EXPENSE' AS type, cp.id_cost_center, cp.id_classification, cp.value, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM financial.recurring_launches rl WHERE rl.id_movement = cp.id_movement) AS fixed, cp.purchased_on AS occurred_on FROM financial.card_purchases cp JOIN financial.invoices i ON i.id = cp.id_invoice;

rollback.sql:
DROP VIEW financial.report_lines;
CREATE VIEW financial.report_lines AS SELECT m.id_financial_period, m.type, m.id_cost_center, m.id_classification, p.value_paid AS value, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM financial.recurring_launches rl WHERE rl.id_movement = m.id) AS fixed FROM financial.movements m JOIN financial.payments p ON p.id_movement = m.id WHERE p.method = 'WALLET' AND m.id_invoice IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT i.id_financial_period, 'EXPENSE' AS type, cp.id_cost_center, cp.id_classification, cp.value, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM financial.recurring_launches rl WHERE rl.id_movement = cp.id_movement) AS fixed FROM financial.card_purchases cp JOIN financial.invoices i ON i.id = cp.id_invoice;
